description: Mortgage loan amounts are constrained to a minimum of £50,000 and a maximum of £500,000.

name: Mortgage Term Constraint
description: Mortgage terms are available for periods ranging from 2 to 25 years.

name: Mortgage Underwriting
description: The department responsible for evaluating and approving mortgage applications through a structured underwriting process. Manages documentation collection, credit assessment, property valuation review, and affordability evaluation.

name: Proof of Income
description: Required documentation demonstrating a customer's income history, submitted as either the last 3 years of accounts or 3 months of payslips as part of the mortgage underwriting process.
context: Proof of income (last 3 years accounts or 3 months payslips)

name: Property Valuation
description: An independent assessment of the property value required as part of mortgage underwriting documentation to establish the security value of the loan.

name: Proof of Deposit
description: Documentation evidencing the customer's deposit contribution toward the mortgage purchase, required as part of the underwriting documentation package.

name: Credit Check
description: A credit assessment performed during mortgage underwriting to evaluate the applicant's creditworthiness and historical credit behavior.

name: Affordability Assessment
description: A mandatory evaluation of the customer's ability to service the mortgage debt based on income, expenditure, and financial obligations, conducted as part of the underwriting process.

name: Mortgage Underwriting SOP
description: The standard operating procedure governing the mortgage underwriting process, including required documentation, assessment criteria, and approval workflows.

name: Debit Card
description: A Visa-branded debit card product launched in June 2018 and currently active. This is a core payment card offering that enables customers to access funds directly from their linked accounts.

name: Debit Card Product
description: A payment card product offering within FirstUK Bank's portfolio, identified as CARD-001 with Visa Debit branding. The product was launched on 2018-06-01 and maintains active status.

name: Visa Debit Card
description: A Visa-branded debit card issued on recycled plastic material with a 4-digit PIN and 3-year validity period. The card supports contactless payments up to £100 per transaction and ATM withdrawals up to £500 daily, with international use enabled across the Visa network.

name: Replacement Card
description: A replacement card issued when the original Visa Debit Card requires renewal or reissuance. The first card is issued free of charge; subsequent replacements incur a £15 fee.

name: Contactless Payment Limit
description: A transaction limit governing contactless payment transactions on the Visa Debit Card, capped at £100 per individual transaction.

name: Daily ATM Withdrawal Limit
description: An operational limit restricting the total amount that can be withdrawn from ATMs in a single calendar day using the Visa Debit Card, set at £500.

name: Card Validity Period
description: The operational lifespan of an issued Visa Debit Card before expiration and replacement is required.

name: Replacement Card Fee
description: The charge levied to customers for replacement card issuance, with an exception for the first card issued at no cost.

name: Debit Card
description: A payment card with multiple security and convenience features including biometric authentication, contactless payment capability, and real-time fraud detection. Supports ATM withdrawals in UK and international locations, online shopping, and virtual card number generation for secure online transactions.

name: Card Management Application
description: A mobile application that enables customers to manage their debit card, including biometric authentication, transaction notifications via push or SMS, card lock/unlock functionality, and access to real-time fraud detection alerts.

name: Real-Time Fraud Detection
description: An automated fraud detection system that monitors card transactions in real-time to identify and alert on suspicious activity, protecting customers from unauthorized use.

name: Virtual Card Number
description: A card feature that generates a unique virtual card number for online payments, providing enhanced security for e-commerce transactions by masking the primary card number.

name: Transaction Notification
description: A real-time notification service that alerts customers to card transactions via push notifications or SMS, enabling immediate awareness of account activity.

name: Biometric Authentication
description: A security feature available through the card management app that uses biometric verification (fingerprint or facial recognition) to authenticate card transactions and app access.

name: Contactless Payment
description: A payment capability that allows customers to make transactions by tapping or waving their card near a contactless-enabled terminal without inserting or swiping the card.

name: Card Lock/Unlock
description: A card management feature accessible via the mobile app that allows customers to temporarily lock or unlock their card to prevent or enable transactions.

name: Fraud Alert
description: A fraud detection and response mechanism governing customer and bank liability for unauthorized transactions, with defined reimbursement timelines and reporting obligations.
context: Customer liability: £0 if reported within 24 hours
Fraud reimbursement: Within 10 business days of claim

name: Fraud Liability Customer Reporting Obligation
description: Customers must report fraud within 24 hours to avoid liability for unauthorized transactions. Failure to report within this window shifts liability to the customer.
context: Customer liability: £0 if reported within 24 hours

name: Bank Fraud Liability Coverage
description: The bank assumes 100% liability for all unauthorized transactions, establishing full protection for customers against fraudulent activity on their accounts.

name: Fraud Reimbursement Processing Timeline
description: Fraud reimbursement claims must be processed and completed within 10 business days of the claim submission date.
context: Fraud reimbursement: Within 10 business days of claim

name: Total Cards Issued
description: The cumulative count of payment cards issued to customers under the fraud protection program.

name: Active Cards
description: The current number of issued cards that remain active and in use by customers.

name: Monthly Fraud Claims
description: The typical monthly volume of fraud claims submitted by customers, used as a performance indicator for fraud activity levels.

name: Fraud Policy
description: The authoritative policy document governing fraud liability, customer reporting obligations, bank reimbursement responsibilities, and fraud claim processing procedures.
